test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Gabriel is sitting second to the right of Suchita. Ritesh is sitting second to the right of Trinabh. Sourav is an immediate neighbour of both Gabriel and Dhruv. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Ritesh and Trinabh?
solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Gabriel is sitting second to the right of Suchita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c91b8ed6d542a2f8396d1a727d43f0987cdbbf862eab97c0ccf16b40a00691.png] 

2) Sourav is an immediate neighbour of both Gabriel and Dhruv.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b321137a28e2c72f120526a3d392f8b7d86750ca1c9d90906b8ccd4b2c7abba3.png] 

3) Ritesh is sitting second to the right of Trinabh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d73880b51bf04a84157f88abdd5211c93ffa054ba519d5840a72e2b1ee13a27a.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Suchita is an immediate neighbour of both Ritesh and Trinabh.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
